articles.title: Calling All Builders: Meet Orca Security at AWS re:Invent 2026
articles.context: This is an invitation-only evening for technology, cloud, and security leaders, and space is limited
articles.full_text:
Software isn’t just built by developers anymore. Business teams, citizen developers, and AI agents are all shipping apps now, on top of more code, more models, and more cloud than ever. AWS re:Invent is where the people doing that building get together, and we can’t think of a better place to be.

We’re heading to Las Vegas from November 30 to December 4 to talk about what it takes to move fast and still know what you’re shipping. For us, the answer is context: deep, accurate, actionable security that travels with your cloud and AI from development to runtime.

Here’s where to find the Orca Pod.

1. Visit us at Booth #886 at the Venetian Expo

Stop by to see how Orca shows you what your teams have actually built, including what’s coming out of AI app generation platforms, and connects the dots across code, cloud, identities, and AI workloads. Not just “this bucket is public,” but which change made it public and who owns it. That’s the difference between an alert and something your team can actually fix.

We’ll also have cold brew in the booth, Dec 1 to Dec 3, from 10am to 1pm, plus our prize wheel. Spin it, sip something cold, and stay as long as the questions keep coming.

And yes, there’s swag! Get a demo and take home an Orkie, plus socks, Rubik’s cubes, tumblers, and Orkie toys for the four-legged members of your team

Dates: November 30 to December 3Times: 4pm to 7pm Monday (Welcome Reception), 10am to 6pm Tuesday and Wednesday, 10am to 4pm ThursdayLocation: Booth #886, Venetian Expo

2. Meet 1:1 with Orca executives

The show floor isn’t always the best place for a real conversation. We’ve set aside private meeting rooms so you can sit down with Orca leadership and experts to talk through your cloud and AI security priorities.

Want to see how Orca gives builders and security teams the context to ship with confidence on AWS? Request a meeting and our team will reach out to find a date and time that works for you.

Dates: November 30 to December 3Times: By appointmentLocation: The Palazzo and The Venetian

3. Kick off the week at F1 Arcade Las Vegas

Start re:Invent week at full speed. Join Orca Security and Chainguard at F1 Arcade Las Vegas for an evening of great food, great company, and friendly competition. Race your peers head-to-head in immersive F1 simulators, whether you’re chasing the fastest lap or just along for the ride.

Spots are limited and reserved for security, cloud, and technology leaders. Register here

Date: Monday, November 30Time: 7:00 to 9:30 pm PTLocation: F1 Arcade Las Vegas, 3500 Las Vegas Blvd S

4. A night for the builders at The Sphere

Take a break from the re:Invent rush and trade notes with peers on how AI is changing who builds software, and how security keeps up. The evening starts with VIP entry to The Sphere’s Curve Bar for a private networking reception with passed hors d’oeuvres and a full bar. At 8:00 pm, we’ll head inside together for The Wizard of Oz on The Sphere’s wraparound screen.

This is an invitation-only evening for technology, cloud, and security leaders, and space is limited. Request your spot.

Date: Tuesday, December 1Time: 6:50 to 9:15 pm PT (arrive early to allow time for security screening)Location: The Sphere, 255 Sands Ave, Las Vegas

Can’t make it to Vegas?

You don’t need a badge to get started. Orca delivers security for the companies that build. As cloud, applications, AI, and app generation expand the attack surface, Orca turns risk into the context your teams need to act. You get complete visibility across cloud, AI, and application environments, risk correlated across every layer, and the exposures that matter most at the top of the list. Fix faster, and keep building with confidence.

Schedule a 1:1 demo with one of our experts.
